description: Block gained (Dodge Block): 3 + DR bonuses, scaled by modifiers (owner decision 9)
Evasion: armour evasion base plus DEX term capped by the armour DEX cap, plus shield and card bonus (owner decision 11). Feats may raise the armour DEX cap (DECISIONS §15).

Accuracy: STR and DEX plus half WIS and INT, plus one per 5 levels, plus tag bonus (owner decision 11). A Sweep attack also adds the precision term sweep.accuracyBonus (owner decision 16); that term is not in this expression yet
Sweep precision Accuracy bonus: 4 minus targets precision stacks, times 1 Accuracy per stack. +3 at 1 target, +2 at 2, +1 at 3, 0 at 4, -1 at 5 (owner decision 16, 2026-10-13). Proposed

Chance an attack misses. Hit when d20 + accuracy >= 8 + evasion, so the miss count is 7 + evasion - accuracy (of 20). Floor 0.05 is the natural 1 always missing, cap 0.75 is the miss cap. A natural 20 always hits, which the cap already implies (owner decision 11)

Evade evasion, proposed (DECISIONS section 15, rulings 5 to 9 and owner tuning 2026-10-13): base evasion times Evade stacks, plus DEX capped by [evade.dexCap] (min(DEX, cap), no -1), plus the Evade stance bonus [evade.stanceBonus] (3, while the stance is active), plus other evasion bonuses (evasion.cardBonus). [armor.evasionBase] is 0 unless the armour has an evasion tag (ruling 7). The DEX cap is cap = bandCap + floor(armourRank / evade.dexCap.rankStep) + feat raises, where bandCap is selected by the wearer load band (src/content/prototypes/combatEquipment.js:9; src/model/equipmentCombatProfile.js:85): cloth and light 99 (uncapped), medium 5, heavy 2; rankStep 3 (armour:medium and armour:heavy ranks 1 to 10, so medium reaches 8 and heavy 5 at rank 10). Feat raises are open (proposals/evade-cap-feats.md). A generic shield bonus is not included; buckler tags are a separate feature. evasion.rating is unchanged and keeps its per-armour caps.
